name: @usrp/feature-field-ops
description: Walk-in registration and vetting (RDF only). Device enrolment, score sync and conflict resolution are reachable through the reconciled edge contract; durable offline capture remains disabled until its queue and replay proof exist.
//dependencies: @usrp/api-client supplies the ONE contract-asserted transport. Three field-sync operations are implemented upstream and active at the reconciled edge: enroll-device, sync-scores and resolve-conflict. Only verifyBiometric remains unverified and is recorded as unserved rather than invented. Durable offline capture remains disabled until encrypted local persistence, replay ownership and conflict UI are proven. See src/api/transport.ts.
//peerDependencies: React, ReactDOM and the router are PEERS, not dependencies. The host app owns the single instance; a second React in the graph throws 'invalid hook call' and resolves context to the wrong provider. The devDependency copies exist only so this slice typechecks and tests standalone.
